tone.summary: A gentle signal chain focusing on compression for warmth, a clean pre-amp (Boost/Comp), and a small, vintage British amp model with minimal room reverb to capture the delicate, fingerpicked acoustic feel.

rig.name: Elliott Smith - Between The Bars - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and fingerpicking transients.
Smooth out the dynamics of fingerpicked arpeggios and add body warmth.
Provide subtle lift and clarity without adding grit.
blocks.gap: Using Boost for gentle tone shaping, as a dedicated clean pre-amp is not available.

blocks.purpose: Bypass (No drive needed for clean tone).
Simulate a small, clean, vintage American amp for clarity and warmth.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is chosen over the Silver Twin to avoid excessive 'sheen' while maintaining cleanliness.

blocks.purpose: Provide a focused, intimate sound image suitable for close recording.
Tame boxiness and add subtle air to enhance the acoustic-electric warmth.
Add a subtle, intimate room ambiance without sounding like heavy reverb.
blocks.gap: The Room module is preferred over Plate/Spring for its natural, non-metallic decay character.

improvements.summary: Improve cabinet realism to better capture the intimate, close-mic'd acoustic feel.
